name: Hide AI
author: Andrew Hoyer

sections.description:
This plugin is for WordPress users who want a clutter-free interface, without AI buttons and options taking up space.

The point is not to discourage the use of AI in general. In fact, AI was used in research and development, and creation of assets for this plugin. However, theme and plugin developers are injecting buttons and links into core interfaces of the WordPress admin area, the Gutenburg editor, and even their own workflows.

Details

AI options are hidden anywhere in the WordPress admin area including the dashboard, admin toolbar, sidebar, and any other workflow that exists in the admin area.

Hide AI does not concern itself with plugins that are specifically and exclusively about AI, but rather with ones that are layering AI on top of their core service.

How to use

Simply install and activate the plugin. That’s it! There are no settings or options. The plugin takes action only in the admin area, and will automatically hide content from known sources.

Plugins and Themes

The plugin hides AI options generated by the following:

  • All in One SEO
  • Elementor
  • Otter Blocks
  • PostX
  • Rank Math SEO
  • SeedProd
  • Spectra
  • WPCode
  • Yoast

If you use a plugin or theme that is adding AI buttons to the interface, please submit a Support request to have it included in a later version:

Developers

If you’re interested in furthering the development of the Hide AI plugin, please find the project on GitHub:

https://github.com/andrewhoyer/wp-hide-ai/

sections.faq:
How can I help?

There are a few ways you can help make Hide AI better and support more development:

  • Install it on WordPress sites you manage or are developing
  • Tell your friends, write a blog post, mention it on social media, etc
  • Follow the project on GitHub
  • Add a Support request with additional AI options that can be hidden

Why am I still seeing certain AI buttons or links even after installing the plugin?

First, check the “Plugins and Themes” list to see if the one you are using is listed.

This plugin will be a constantly growing project. If you are using a theme or plugin that is injecting an AI link or button that isn’t covered, please add a request to the support forum:

https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/hide-ai/
